integrity: The Nijenhuis equations are solved directly over an arbitrary field, the automorphism groups are computed from the multiplication tables, and the conjugation action is reduced to one scalar weight. A standalone exhaustive checker independently verifies the operator sets, automorphism groups, orbit partitions, square-zero counts, and idempotent counts over several finite fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the pre-Lie algebras A2 and A3, not the complete two-dimensional list.
The source's parametric classification is over the complex numbers; the arbitrary-field extension is established independently in the proof.
A later or unindexed conjugacy classification may exist despite the targeted searches.
title: Two distinct pre-Lie algebras have the same Nijenhuis orbit space
